name: Runemaster Advanced Magi raises Elemental Burst spell power scaling (#466)
contract: Tooltip 804557: 'Increases the spell power scaling of Elemental Burst by $s2%'.
Effect 1 is a percent modifier (aura 108), BasePoints 24 (+25%), on family 38 mask2 0x20000.
Only the Elemental Burst ranks (802202, 502828-502838) and their helpers carry mask2 0x20000.
MiscValue 41 is Ascension's private spell power coefficient operation, outside the 3.3.5a SpellModOp range.
SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER (24) is the operation SpellDamageBonusDone applies to the spell power coefficient.
Elemental Burst's coefficient is 0.55 ($SP*.55), so 55 must become 68.75 on every rank.
Primordial Blast 800732 keeps 55, and the Elemental Burst direct damage modifier does not change.

steps.label: Without Advanced Magi the Elemental Burst coefficient is unmodified
Elemental Burst direct damage modifier before Advanced Magi
Advanced Magi raises Elemental Burst rank 1 spell power scaling by 25%
Advanced Magi raises Elemental Burst rank 12 spell power scaling by 25%
Primordial Blast, another Runemaster damage spell, keeps its coefficient
Advanced Magi does not change the Elemental Burst direct damage modifier
Removing Advanced Magi restores the original coefficient
